```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform divider splits a patterned panel from a mostly uniform panel.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))

    # Mark the exceptional cells in the right panel, except where the left
    # panel has a blocker (color 4 in the first example).
    bg = max(set(x for row in right for x in row),
             key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in right))
    mark = next((x for x in set(x for row in right for x in row) if x != bg), None)
    return [[3 if right[r][c] == mark and left[r][c] != 4 else 1
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
```
